name: DeepLedger
description: DeepLedger lets agents read and record transactions, reports, receivables and payables in QuickBooks Online, Xero and Bill.com, and help with reconciliation and month-end close. Each user signs in to their own DeepLedger account through the browser.

prompts.text: Show the profit and loss report for last month.
Which bank transactions are still uncategorized?
Which invoices are more than 30 days overdue?

apps.name: DeepLedger
apps.description: Bookkeeping, reports, and month-end close, over DeepLedger's MCP server with browser sign-in.
